Dover Cyclery Tuesday Night Ride

Dover, NH · Road

Dover Cyclery Tuesday Night Ride is a road group ride in Dover, NH. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Dover Cyclery.

Next ride Tue, Oct 6, 5:30 PM EDT

Checked Oct 1, 2026. Confirmed against the sources at the foot of this page. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

Dover Cyclery's group-rides page lists the Tuesday Night Ride at around 5:30 pm, intermediate, 19-20 mph, on a page with a 2026 copyright (fetched Oct 1, 2026). Nothing on it is dated after April 2026.

For visitors

Daylight is short in October, bring lights. Ask in the shop for ride reminders.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19-20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Dover Cyclery Tuesday Night Ride group ride

An intermediate road ride rolling out of the shop at about 5:30 pm, at 19 to 20 mph for 30 to 45 miles depending on daylight. Talk to Mike in the shop to get on the reminder list.
